NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and conditions contained

1.
Description of Premises: The City leases to the Lessee the following described real
property(hereinafter"Premises").
That portion of the tract of land described in DEEDWITHOUT WARRANTY, recorded

extended westerly to the easterly right of way of I-25, and northerly of the existing cul-de-
sac at the west end of Talbot Court, but reserving a strip of land, twenty (20)feet in width
along, adjacent and parallel to the easterly right of way of I-25, in Pioneer Park, City of
Cheyenne, Laramie County, Wyoming, Said parcel containing 1.3 acre more or less.
Said parcel being depicted on Exhibit A attached hereto.
2.Term: The term of this Agreement shall be for five (5) years beginning on the
date of execution of this lease by City and Lessee.It is agreed that the City may terminate this
Agreement by providing no less than one (1) year's writen notice to Lessee.
3. Rent: The Lessee shall pay as rental for the Premises the sum of Ten Dollars
(10.00) per year, which annual rental shall be paid within thirty (30) days after the execution of
this Agreement, andwithin thirty(30)days after each anniversary of the execution of this
Agreement.
4.Permitted Uses: The Premises shall be used by the Lessee for the purposes of
temporary installation, maintenance and use of modular classrooms and related temporary
facilities necessary for customary school services and activities. The City reserves the right,
upon ten(1o)days written notice, torequire the Lesseeto discontinue any specificuse ofthe
Premises other than purposes stated herein.

Governmental Immunity: The City and Lessee expressly reserves the right to
invoke governmental immunity pursuant to the Wyoming Governmental Claims Act,  1-39-101,
et seq., with respect to any claims, demands, or causes of action which may be asserted against
the party or parties to this Agreement.
 7. Improvements: The Lessee agrees not to make any improvement, modification or
alteration of the Premises without the express knowledge and written consent of the City of
Cheyenne. All permanent improvements made to the Premises shall remain with the Premises
and become the property of the City at the expiration of this Agreement.
8.Lessee's Maintenance Responsibilities: The Lessee agrees to perform all
reasonable and necessary maintenance of the premises including, but not limited to, compliance
with all provisions of the Cheyenne City Code, state laws, and federal laws which relate to the
use of real property, including protection of the environment.
 9. Liens and Encumbrances: The Lessee agrees not to incur any indebtedness
which will, or may become a lien or encumbrance upon the Premises, nor to allow any mechanic,
builder, materialman, or other claimant to assert any lien against the Premises. The Lessee
further agrees to discharge any such liens or encumbrances as soon as the same shall have been
asserted against the Premises and shall indemnify and hold the City harmless from the same.
10.Surrender of Premises at Conclusion of Lease Term: At the conclusion of the
lease period or termination of this Agreement, the Lessee shall return the Premises to the City in
the same condition as received, less reasonable wear and tear. Unless otherwise directed by the
City, the District shall, upon termination of this Agreement, remove all temporary improvements,
fixtures, equipment, and other personal property placed on the Premises by Lessee.
11. Assignment: This Agreement may not be assigned without the prior written
consent of the City.
12.Conformance with Law: The Lessee agrees to comply with all laws in the
performance of this Agreement.

covenants or conditions hereof to be performed, kept and observed by the Lessee shall be
construed as, or operate as, a waiverby the City of any subsequent default ofany of the terms
covenants or conditions herein contained to be performed, kept and observed by the Lessee.
14.Holding Over: The Lessee covenants that at the expiration of the period for
which the Premises are leased to it, or at the earlier termination of this Agreement, it will quit
and surrender the Premises together with fixtures on the property in good state and condition
reasonable wear and tear excepted.Should the Lessee hold over the use of or continue to occupy
the Premises after the expiration of the Agreement, such holding over will be as a tenant at
sufferance for whichuse it shall beliablefor any and all damages resulting from such tenancy.
15. Covenant of Quiet Enjoyment: The City covenants for itself, its successors and
assigns that the Lessee, upon payment of the rent and performance of the Lessee's other
covenants herein, shall and may peaceably and quietly have, hold and enjoy the demised
Premises during the term of this Agreement, provided however, that the City reserves the right to
locate a greenway trail in and along the strip of land, twenty feet (20') feet in width along,
adjacent to and parallel to the easterly right of way of Interstate 25, as set forth in the legal
description above. In the event the City elects to locate a greenway trail in said strip of land, the
City shall provide ninety (90) days written notice of its intentions to the District.
